, as the world becomes increasingly urbanized and the urbanization process becomes increasingly global, urban design and planning must respond to the challenges of a more complex and diverse urban condition, which requires new approaches, new tools, new skills and new knowledge, which in turn requires the involvement of a wider range of actors and stakeholders in the process of urban transformation.

the new urban question is the challenge for the new millennium for urban design and planning and that the University, in particular through international cooperation, is called upon to support a more sustainable and equal development model, in the North as well as in the South, by spreading the most advanced and updated knowledge on emerging problems.

the new global urban question is not a problem that can be solved by the University alone, but rather it is a challenge that can be faced only by means of the collaboration and the synergy between all of the actors involved in the process.
